title: Preregistered Volatility Gating & Leveraged Exposure Risk Experiment Specification

historical_linkage.prior_research: Stage 6 / candidate_alpha.py previously investigated an overlay threshold of 0.22 alongside inverse-volatility weighting. Candidate C1 tests the fixed 0.22 overlay gate in isolation within the production architecture, and is classified as previously explored in concept rather than de novo discovery.

common_contract.execution_timing: Signals at close T, fills at open T+1

general_risk_on_contract.rule: spy[-1] > spy_sma50 and qqq[-1] > qqq_sma50 and qqq_vol20 < 0.35

C1.name: Candidate C1: Tightened Leverage-Volatility Gate
C1.hypothesis: Restricting the 2x leveraged ETF overlay to calm market regimes defined by QQQ 20-day realized volatility < 0.22 (versus baseline 0.28) eliminates leveraged exposure during transitionary volatility spikes, reducing maximum drawdown without incurring excessive drag during sustained bull trends.
C1.algorithm: Overlay allowed iff: qqq_sma20 > qqq_sma50 and qqq_mom20 > 0.0 and qqq_vol20 < 0.22 and QLD in universe and SSO in universe.

C2.name: Candidate C2: Volatility-Acceleration Gate
C2.hypothesis: An abrupt acceleration in short-term volatility (sigma_5 / sigma_20 > 1.25) reliably flags volatility shocks before the 20-day trailing metric reflects the stress. Blocking the leveraged overlay under volatility expansion preserves capital ahead of cascading sell-offs.
C2.annualization_definition: Both sigma_5 and sigma_20 are calculated using standard realized volatility with sqrt(252) annualization: pstdev(rets) * sqrt(252). The ratio sigma_5 / sigma_20 is identical to unannualized pstdev(rets_5) / pstdev(rets_20).
C2.zero_denominator_handling: If sigma_20 <= 1e-6 or sigma_20 is None or sigma_5 is None: ratio is undefined; overlay condition evaluates to False.
C2.algorithm: Overlay allowed iff: baseline overlay conditions hold (including qqq_vol20 < 0.28) AND sigma_5 / sigma_20 <= 1.25.

C3.name: Candidate C3: Volatility-Persistence Gate
C3.hypothesis: Single-session volatility spikes above the 0.28 overlay threshold frequently represent transient noise that causes premature overlay liquidation and churn costs. Requiring 2 consecutive sessions of adverse volatility (qqq_vol20 >= 0.28) before deactivating the overlay reduces whipsaw and friction, while preserving emergency exits if the broader strategy triggers risk-off.

algorithm_specification.entry: Overlay activation requires current session to fully satisfy baseline overlay rules: qqq_sma20 > qqq_sma50, qqq_mom20 > 0.0, qqq_vol20 < 0.28.
algorithm_specification.maintenance: When overlay is currently active: if qqq_vol20 >= 0.28, increment adverse_counter. Deactivate overlay ONLY when adverse_counter >= 2.
algorithm_specification.emergency_exit: If general market goes risk-off (spy < spy_sma50 or qqq < qqq_sma50 or qqq_vol20 >= 0.35): IMMEDIATE FULL EXIT of overlay and risk-on portfolio, transitioning instantly to defensive sleeve without waiting for persistence counter.
algorithm_specification.non_volatility_exit: If QQQ trend fails (sma20 <= sma50 or mom20 <= 0.0): immediate deactivation of overlay.
algorithm_specification.missing_data: If QQQ bar is missing, adverse_counter resets to 0 and overlay evaluates to False.

C4.name: Candidate C4: Prespecified Combined Gate (C1 + C2)
C4.hypothesis: Jointly enforcing a tightened volatility ceiling (sigma_20 < 0.22) AND an acceleration barrier (sigma_5 / sigma_20 <= 1.25) creates an orthogonal defense against both elevated baseline volatility and rapid volatility explosions, providing maximal drawdown suppression for leveraged exposure.
C4.algorithm: Overlay allowed iff: qqq_sma20 > qqq_sma50 and qqq_mom20 > 0.0 and qqq_vol20 < 0.22 and (sigma_5 / sigma_20 <= 1.25).

synthetic_stress_scenarios: 2. Slow volatility increase (0.5% vol drift per session over 30 sessions)
3. High-volatility sideways market (choppy +/-3% range with vol ~0.30)
4. False short-term volatility spike (single day outlier that rapidly mean-reverts)
5. V-shaped recovery (sharp 15% drop over 3 days followed by immediate recovery)
6. Persistent low-volatility uptrend (calm 0.12 vol bull market)
7. Leveraged ETF gap against the position (overnight -8% gap in QLD/SSO)
8. Volatility ratio denominator near zero (flat price series with sigma_20 < 1e-6)
9. Missing QQQ observations (intermittent None or missing bar records)
10. Alternating calm and stressed sessions (whipsaw across the 0.28 threshold)
11. Overnight gap beyond modeled slippage (extreme -12% index gap)
12. Conflicting risk-on and risk-off conditions (QQQ uptrend with SPY breakdown)
